baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic, non-explicit fashion editorial inside a decommissioned alpine funicular station in late-night fog with distant harbor rain. A clearly 32-year-old female cinema-restoration specialist, whose facial appearance follows an adult facial-appearance reference only, stands at the brass-latticed ticket-booth threshold with the same clearly 37-year-old male cinematheque curator. Her pupils, head, and torso all converge on the same man. She holds the threshold open with one shoulder while extending a silver film canister toward him across the deliberately empty half of a luggage trolley; a brass signal key and cyanotype route map remain visible beside it. The man has stopped at that exact threshold, turns toward her, and reaches one open hand toward the offered canister. Frame both adults and their complete interaction in a deep vertical environmental two-shot from doorway height on a 28 mm lens. Warm tungsten booth light, cold skylight flashes, and wet-floor reflections shape the scene. She wears an oxblood satin blouse under charcoal wool-gabardine tailoring; both adults are fully dressed, alert, and self-possessed.
